name: smpeg2
reason: SMPEG_new(local tagged MP3) returned no error but SMPEG_Info reported MPEG-1 Layer 1, 22050 Hz stereo and 0.125 s. The valid control is MPEG Layer III, 8000 Hz mono and about 1 s; this is not a correct format-aware parse of the named variant.
